# package: # Locally-provided kernel RPMs for the KERNEL_RPM_SOURCE=local path. Fill in one
# row per RPM with the exact NAME, EPOCH:VERSION-RELEASE, ARCH, and sha256 of the
# RPM. scripts/12a-build-kernel-rpm-carrier.sh verifies every staged RPM against
# these rows (sha256 always; Red Hat signature unless ALLOW_UNSIGNED_KERNEL_RPMS=true)
# before it enters the carrier image. RPM binaries are never committed; stage them
# in KERNEL_RPM_DIR outside this repository.
# Current pin: FIXED + INSTRUMENTED L1VH kernel `...mgns2.el10`, an UNSIGNED
# developer build. It keeps the mgns1 deposit/withdraw tracepoints AND adds the
# candidate fix for the csum_partial #GP root cause
# (issues/2026-09-09d-ROOT-CAUSE-deposited-page-overread.md):
# hv_call_deposit_pages() now removes donated pages from the kernel direct map
# (set_direct_map_valid_noflush + flush_tlb_kernel_range) before handing them to
# the hypervisor, and restores them on the error and withdraw paths. An
# over-read into a deposited page then hits a NOT PRESENT mapping and takes a
# #PF, which load_unaligned_zeropad()'s EX_TYPE_ZEROPAD fixup recovers from,
# instead of the unrecoverable #GP.
# Previous pin was `mgns1.el10` (instrumentation only, no fix). EXPECTED_KERNEL
# in l1vh.env must match this suffix or scripts/12b reports the swap as failed.
# RHCOS 10 installs all five of these subpackages, so all five are replaced
# together. The tarball also ships kernel-devel, kernel-devel-matched,
# kernel-modules-extra-matched, kernel-modules-internal and
# kernel-modules-partner; those are NOT installed on RHCOS and are deliberately
# left out of the carrier.
kernel
kernel-core
kernel-modules
